questions.stem: In the figure, a sequence of patterns is formed by sticks of equal length. (a) Find the number of sticks required to form \(P_{40}\). (b) Find the total required to form all patterns from \(P_{18}\) to \(P_{32}\). (c) There are 2100 sticks available. Elaine wants to form all patterns from \(P_m\) to \(P_{42}\). (i) What is the least value of \(m\)? (ii) How many patterns can be formed?
questions.stemZh: 圖中是一列用等長棒砌成的圖案。(a) 求砌成 \(P_{40}\) 所需棒數。(b) 求砌成 \(P_{18}\) 至 \(P_{32}\) 所有圖案所需的總棒數。(c) Elaine 有 2100 支棒，要砌成 \(P_m\) 至 \(P_{42}\) 的所有圖案。(i) 求 \(m\) 的最小值。(ii) 共可砌多少個圖案？
questions.solution: Each new pattern adds 3 sticks: \(T_n=4+3(n-1)=3n+1\). (a) \(T_{40}=121\). (b) There are \(32-18+1=15\) patterns: \[\frac{15}2[(3\cdot18+1)+(3\cdot32+1)]=1140.\] (c) The required total is \[F(m)=\frac{43-m}2[(3m+1)+127]=\frac{(43-m)(3m+128)}2.\] Check adjacent candidates: \(F(22)=2037\le2100\), but \(F(21)=2101>2100\). Starting earlier adds positive numbers of sticks, so the least \(m\) is 22. The number of patterns is \(42-22+1=21\).

questions.stem:
At the beginning of a month Mr Lee borrowed $\(P\) from a bank at \(r\%\) p.a., compounded monthly. From the beginning of the second month he repays $\(x\) at the beginning of each month until the loan is fully repaid. The last repayment may be less than $\(x\).
(a) Find the balances owed (i) at the end of the first month and (ii) at the end of the second month.
(b) Prove that the balance at the end of the nth month is \[P\left(1+\frac r{1200}\right)^n-x\left(1+\frac r{1200}\right)\frac{(1+r/1200)^{n-1}-1}{r/1200}.\]
(c) Let \(P=100000,r=12\). (i) If the loan is repaid in 28 instalments, find the least value of \(x\), correct to 2 decimal places. (ii) If he repays $5000 each month, when will the loan be fully repaid?
questions.stemZh:
李先生於某月月初向銀行借款 $\(P\)，年利率為 \(r\%\)，每月複息。由第二個月月初開始，每月月初還款 $\(x\)，直至清還；最後一期可少於 $\(x\)。
(a) 求 (i) 第一個月底及 (ii) 第二個月底的欠款。
(b) 證明第 \(n\) 個月底的欠款為 \[P\left(1+\frac r{1200}\right)^n-x\left(1+\frac r{1200}\right)\frac{(1+r/1200)^{n-1}-1}{r/1200}.\]
(c) 設 \(P=100000,r=12\)。(i) 若分 28 期清還，求 \(x\) 的最小值，答案準確至小數點後兩位。(ii) 若每月還 $5000，何時清還？
questions.solution:
Put \(q=1+r/1200\); the percentage must be converted to a decimal before dividing by 12. (a) \(B_1=Pq\) and \(B_2=(Pq-x)q=Pq^2-xq\).
(b) While the loan remains outstanding, \(B_n=q(B_{n-1}-x)\). Expanding gives \[B_n=Pq^n-x(q+q^2+\cdots+q^{n-1})=Pq^n-xq\frac{q^{n-1}-1}{q-1}.\] This is the required formula. It describes the balance before stopping repayments; after payoff the actual balance stays zero. For zero interest take the limit \(B_n=P-(n-1)x\).
(c)(i) Here \(q=1.01\). The 28th payment is at the beginning of month 29. Immediately before it the balance is \(B_{28}\); clearing it requires \(B_{28}\le x\). At the threshold, \[x=\frac{100000(1.01)^{28}(0.01)}{1.01^{28}-1}=4112.443557\ldots.\] To 2 decimal places the mathematical threshold is $4112.44, as in the source key. If instalments themselves must be whole cents, the least sufficient payment is $4112.45: $4112.44 leaves about $0.114 outstanding after the 28th payment. These are different rounding interpretations, not a change to the source conditions.
(c)(ii) After \(k\) payments the formal balance is \[D_k=100000(1.01)^k-5000\frac{1.01^k-1}{0.01}.\] Payoff requires \((1.01)^k\ge5/4\), or \(k\ge\log(5/4)/\log(1.01)\approx22.426\). Thus 23 payments are needed. They start in month 2, so payoff is at the beginning of the 24th month, not the 23rd month. The final payment is smaller than $5000.
questions.solutionZh:
設 \(q=1+r/1200\)；年利率的百分數須先轉成小數，再除以 12。(a) \(B_1=Pq\)，\(B_2=(Pq-x)q=Pq^2-xq\)。
(b) 尚未清還時，\(B_n=q(B_{n-1}-x)\)。逐項展開：\[B_n=Pq^n-x(q+q^2+\cdots+q^{n-1})=Pq^n-xq\frac{q^{n-1}-1}{q-1}.\] 得證。此式適用於未停止供款的期間；清還後實際結餘保持為零。若利率為零，取極限得 \(B_n=P-(n-1)x\)。
(c)(i) 此時 \(q=1.01\)。第 28 期在第 29 個月月初支付，付款前欠款是 \(B_{28}\)，故清還條件為 \(B_{28}\le x\)。臨界值是 \[x=\frac{100000(1.01)^{28}(0.01)}{1.01^{28}-1}=4112.443557\ldots.\] 數學臨界值取兩位小數為 $4112.44，與原答案相同。但若每期金額本身必須是整數仙，最少足額供款應為 $4112.45；供 $4112.44 在第 28 期後仍約欠 $0.114。兩者是取近似值方式的分別，並非改動原題條件。
(c)(ii) 還了 \(k\) 期後，未截斷的結餘式為 \[D_k=100000(1.01)^k-5000\frac{1.01^k-1}{0.01}.\] 清還條件是 \((1.01)^k\ge5/4\)，即 \(k\ge\log(5/4)/\log(1.01)\approx22.426\)，所以要供 23 期。第一期在第二個月，故於第 24 個月月初清還，不是第 23 個月。最後一期少於 $5000。

questions.stem:
Let \(p\) and \(q\) be respectively the sum and product of the roots of \((x+2)(x-2)=8(x-1)\).
(a) Write down the values of \(p\) and \(q\).
(b) A geometric sequence has first term \(\log q\) and second term \(\log p\). Find the greatest value of \(\alpha\) such that the sum of its \((\alpha+1)\)th and \((2\alpha+1)\)th terms is less than \(\log 2^{2020}\).
questions.stemZh:
設 \(p\) 及 \(q\) 分別為二次方程 \((x+2)(x-2)=8(x-1)\) 的兩根之和與積。
(a) 寫出 \(p\) 及 \(q\) 的值。
(b) 某等比數列的首項及第二項分別為 \(\log q\) 及 \(\log p\)。求 \(\alpha\) 的最大值，使該數列第 \((\alpha+1)\) 項與第 \((2\alpha+1)\) 項之和小於 \(\log 2^{2020}\)。
questions.solution:
(a) Expanding gives \(x^2-8x+4=0\). By the sum and product of roots, \(p=8\) and \(q=4\).
(b) The common ratio is \(r=\log8/\log4=3/2\), so \(T_n=2\log2\,(3/2)^{n-1}\). The term indices imply that \(\alpha\) is a nonnegative integer. Cancel the positive factor \(2\log2\) to obtain \[(3/2)^\alpha+(3/2)^{2\alpha}<1010.\] Set \(t=(3/2)^\alpha>0\). Then \(t^2+t-1010<0\), hence \(t<(\sqrt{4041}-1)/2\). Therefore \(\alpha<\log[(\sqrt{4041}-1)/2]/\log(3/2)\approx8.49\). The greatest value is \(\boxed{8}\). Direct substitution confirms that 8 satisfies the strict inequality and 9 does not.
questions.solutionZh:
(a) 展開得 \(x^2-8x+4=0\)。由根與係數關係，\(p=8\)、\(q=4\)。
(b) 公比為 \(r=\log8/\log4=3/2\)，故 \(T_n=2\log2\,(3/2)^{n-1}\)。由項數必須為正整數，\(\alpha\) 為非負整數。兩邊除以正數 \(2\log2\)，得 \[(3/2)^\alpha+(3/2)^{2\alpha}<1010.\] 令 \(t=(3/2)^\alpha>0\)，則 \(t^2+t-1010<0\)，即 \(t<(\sqrt{4041}-1)/2\)。取對數得 \(\alpha<8.49\)（約值），故最大值為 \(\boxed{8}\)。回代 8 及 9 可確認嚴格不等號的整數邊界。

en.text: Let \(p\) and \(q\) be respectively the sum and product of the roots of \((x+2)(x-2)=8(x-1)\).
(a) Write down the values of \(p\) and \(q\).

(b) A geometric sequence has first term \(\log q\) and second term \(\log p\). Find the greatest value of \(\alpha\) such that the sum of its \((\alpha+1)\)th and \((2\alpha+1)\)th terms is less than \(\log 2^{2020}\).

zh-Hant.text: 設 \(p\) 及 \(q\) 分別為二次方程 \((x+2)(x-2)=8(x-1)\) 的兩根之和與積。
(b) 某等比數列的首項及第二項分別為 \(\log q\) 及 \(\log p\)。求 \(\alpha\) 的最大值，使該數列第 \((\alpha+1)\) 項與第 \((2\alpha+1)\) 項之和小於 \(\log 2^{2020}\)。

questions.sourceZh: S6/Sequence/APGP review.pdf · 第4題（未提供原出處）
questions.stem:
A geometric sequence has first term \(2048\) and sum of its first three terms \(5408\). Let \(r\) be its common ratio.
(a) Find the values of \(r\).
(b) Its sum to infinity exists. Find the least value of \(n\) such that the sum of its first \(n\) terms is greater than \(16270\).
questions.stemZh:
某等比數列的首項為 \(2048\)，首三項之和為 \(5408\)。設公比為 \(r\)。
(a) 求 \(r\) 的值。
(b) 已知該數列的無窮和存在。求最小的 \(n\)，使首 \(n\) 項之和大於 \(16270\)。
questions.solution:
(a) Use the three terms directly: \(2048(1+r+r^2)=5408\). Thus \(64r^2+64r-105=(8r-7)(8r+15)=0\), giving \(\boxed{r=7/8\text{ or }-15/8}\). Both satisfy the three-term sum; neither may be discarded in part (a).
(b) Convergence requires \(|r|<1\), so \(r=7/8\). Then \[S_n=16384\left[1-(7/8)^n\right]>16270\quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad(7/8)^n<57/8192.\] Since \(\log(7/8)<0\), dividing reverses the inequality: \(n>\log(57/8192)/\log(7/8)\approx37.20\). Hence the least value is \(\boxed{38}\); indeed \(S_{37}\le16270<S_{38}\).

en.text: A geometric sequence has first term \(2048\) and sum of its first three terms \(5408\). Let \(r\) be its common ratio.
(a) Find the values of \(r\).
(b) Its sum to infinity exists. Find the least value of \(n\) such that the sum of its first \(n\) terms is greater than \(16270\).

zh-Hant.text: 某等比數列的首項為 \(2048\)，首三項之和為 \(5408\)。設公比為 \(r\)。
(b) 已知該數列的無窮和存在。求最小的 \(n\)，使首 \(n\) 項之和大於 \(16270\)。

questions.sourceZh: S6/Sequence/APGP review.pdf · 第5題（未提供原出處）
questions.stem:
The second term of a geometric sequence is \(200\) and its sum to infinity is \(800\).
(a) Find its first term and common ratio.
(b) Find the least value of \(n\) such that the sum of its first \(n\) terms is greater than \(800(1-10^{-10})\).
questions.stemZh:
某等比數列的第二項為 \(200\)，無窮和為 \(800\)。
(a) 求首項及公比。
(b) 求最小的 \(n\)，使首 \(n\) 項之和大於 \(800(1-10^{-10})\)。
questions.solution:
(a) Let the first term be \(a\) and the common ratio be \(r\), where \(|r|<1\). From \(ar=200\) and \(a/(1-r)=800\), obtain \(r(1-r)=1/4\), so \((2r-1)^2=0\). Therefore \(\boxed{r=1/2,\ a=400}\).
(b) \(S_n=800(1-2^{-n})\). The strict condition is \(2^{-n}<10^{-10}\), or \(n>10/\log2\approx33.21928\), with common logarithms. Thus \(\boxed{n=34}\) is the least value. Check the exact powers at 33 and 34 rather than rounding the near-limit sums to 800.

en.text: The second term of a geometric sequence is \(200\) and its sum to infinity is \(800\).
(a) Find its first term and common ratio.
(b) Find the least value of \(n\) such that the sum of its first \(n\) terms is greater than \(800(1-10^{-10})\).

zh-Hant.text: 某等比數列的第二項為 \(200\)，無窮和為 \(800\)。

questions.sourceZh: S6/Sequence/APGP review.pdf · 第6題（未提供原出處）
questions.stem:
Let \(G(n)\) be the \(n\)th term of a geometric sequence. It is given that \(G(2)=100\) and \(G(5)=256/5\).
(a) Find \(G(1)\).
(b) Is it possible that the sum of the first \(n\) terms is greater than \(630\)? Explain.
(c) Find the least value of \(k\) such that \(G(k+1)+G(2k+1)<20\).
questions.solution:
(a) If the common ratio is \(r\), then \(r^3=G(5)/G(2)=64/125\). Its unique real root is \(r=4/5\), so \(\boxed{G(1)=125}\).
(b) No. Every term is positive and \(S_n=625[1-(4/5)^n]<625<630\).
(c) Put \(t=(4/5)^k>0\). Then \(125(t+t^2)<20\), or \(25t^2+25t-4<0\). Hence \(t<(\sqrt{41}-5)/10\). Taking logarithms and reversing the inequality when dividing by \(\log(4/5)<0\) gives \[k>\frac{\log[(\sqrt{41}-5)/10]}{\log(4/5)}\approx8.80099.\] The least value is \(\boxed{9}\). The exact expression is at least 20 for \(k=8\) and less than 20 for \(k=9\); it decreases thereafter.

en.text: Let \(G(n)\) be the \(n\)th term of a geometric sequence. It is given that \(G(2)=100\) and \(G(5)=256/5\).
(b) Is it possible that the sum of the first \(n\) terms is greater than \(630\)? Explain.
(c) Find the least value of \(k\) such that \(G(k+1)+G(2k+1)<20\).

zh-Hant.text: (b) 首 \(n\) 項之和有沒有可能大於 \(630\)？解釋你的答案。

questions.sourceZh: S6/Sequence/APGP review.pdf · 第7題（未提供原出處）
questions.stem:
Real numbers \(\alpha\) and \(\beta\) satisfy \(2^{\beta-\alpha}=16\) and \(\log_2(2\alpha+\beta)=4\).
(a) Find \(\alpha\) and \(\beta\).
(b) A geometric sequence has first term \(\log\alpha\) and second term \(\log\beta\). Find the least value of \(n\) such that the sum of its first \(n\) terms is greater than \(1000\).
questions.stemZh:
實數 \(\alpha\)、\(\beta\) 滿足 \(2^{\beta-\alpha}=16\) 及 \(\log_2(2\alpha+\beta)=4\)。
(a) 求 \(\alpha\) 及 \(\beta\)。
(b) 某等比數列的首項及第二項分別為 \(\log\alpha\) 及 \(\log\beta\)。求最小的 \(n\)，使首 \(n\) 項之和大於 \(1000\)。
questions.solution:
(a) The two conditions give \(\beta-\alpha=4\) and \(2\alpha+\beta=16\). Thus \(\boxed{\alpha=4,\ \beta=8}\); both logarithms in part (b) are defined.
(b) Using common logarithms, the first term is \(2\log2\) and the ratio is \(3/2\). Therefore \[S_n=4\log2\left[(3/2)^n-1\right]>1000.\] Since \(\log2>0\), this gives \((3/2)^n>1+250/\log2\), hence \(n>\log(1+250/\log2)/\log(3/2)\approx16.58148\). The least value is \(\boxed{17}\); direct sums satisfy \(S_{16}\le1000<S_{17}\). Note that the subscripted logarithm in part (a) has base 2, while the unbased logarithms in part (b) are common logarithms.
questions.solutionZh:
(a) 兩個條件分別化為 \(\beta-\alpha=4\)、\(2\alpha+\beta=16\)。聯立得 \(\boxed{\alpha=4,\ \beta=8}\)，兩數均為正，(b) 的對數有定義。
(b) 用常用對數，首項為 \(2\log2\)，公比為 \(3/2\)。因此 \[S_n=4\log2[(3/2)^n-1]>1000.\] 由 \(\log2>0\)，得 \((3/2)^n>1+250/\log2\)。取對數後 \(n>16.58148\)（約值），故最小值為 \(\boxed{17}\)。回代有 \(S_{16}\le1000<S_{17}\)。留意 (a) 的下標對數以 2 為底，(b) 沒有下標的對數則是常用對數。

en.text: Real numbers \(\alpha\) and \(\beta\) satisfy \(2^{\beta-\alpha}=16\) and \(\log_2(2\alpha+\beta)=4\).
(a) Find \(\alpha\) and \(\beta\).
(b) A geometric sequence has first term \(\log\alpha\) and second term \(\log\beta\). Find the least value of \(n\) such that the sum of its first \(n\) terms is greater than \(1000\).

zh-Hant.text: (b) 某等比數列的首項及第二項分別為 \(\log\alpha\) 及 \(\log\beta\)。求最小的 \(n\)，使首 \(n\) 項之和大於 \(1000\)。

questions.sourceZh: S6/Sequence/APGP review.pdf · 第8題（未提供原出處）
questions.stem:
Let \(a_n\) be the \(n\)th term of sequence \(X\). For every positive integer \(n\), \(a_{2n+2}=a_{2n}+2\) and \(a_{2n+1}=a_{2n-1}-3\). It is given that \(a_2=7\) and \(a_3=63\).
(a) Find \(a_1\) and \(a_4\).
(b) If \(m\) is an integer, find the smallest value of \(m\) such that the sum of the first \((2m-1)\) terms of \(X\) is greater than \(2251\).
(c) Let \(b_n\) be the \(n\)th term of sequence \(Y\), where \(b_n=1.2^{a_{2n}}\) for every positive integer \(n\). Find the greatest value of \(k\) such that the product of its first \(k\) terms is less than \(10^{30}\).
questions.solution:
(a) \(a_3=a_1-3=63\), so \(\boxed{a_1=66}\); also \(\boxed{a_4=a_2+2=9}\).
(b) Odd-indexed terms form an AP with first term 66 and difference -3; even-indexed terms form an AP with first term 7 and difference 2. Among the first \(2m-1\) terms there are \(m\) odd-indexed terms and \(m-1\) even-indexed terms. Thus \[S_{2m-1}=\frac m2[132-3(m-1)]+\frac{m-1}{2}[14+2(m-2)]=\frac{-m^2+143m-10}{2}.\] The condition becomes \(m^2-143m+4512=(m-47)(m-96)<0\). Hence \(47<m<96\), and the smallest integer is \(\boxed{48}\). Both endpoints give equality, not an admissible sum; the sum is not assumed to increase for all \(m\).
(c) \(a_{2n}=7+2(n-1)=2n+5\). Hence \[\prod_{n=1}^{k}b_n=1.2^{\sum_{n=1}^{k}(2n+5)}=1.2^{k(k+6)}.\] Taking common logarithms gives \(k(k+6)\log1.2<30\). Therefore \(k<-3+\sqrt{9+30/\log1.2}\approx16.69461\), so the greatest value is \(\boxed{16}\). Exact powers confirm the boundary at 16 and 17.

en.text: Let \(a_n\) be the \(n\)th term of sequence \(X\). For every positive integer \(n\), \(a_{2n+2}=a_{2n}+2\) and \(a_{2n+1}=a_{2n-1}-3\). It is given that \(a_2=7\) and \(a_3=63\).
(a) Find \(a_1\) and \(a_4\).
(b) If \(m\) is an integer, find the smallest value of \(m\) such that the sum of the first \((2m-1)\) terms of \(X\) is greater than \(2251\).

(c) Let \(b_n\) be the \(n\)th term of sequence \(Y\), where \(b_n=1.2^{a_{2n}}\) for every positive integer \(n\). Find the greatest value of \(k\) such that the product of its first \(k\) terms is less than \(10^{30}\).

questions.stem: Which of the following may represent the nth term of the sequence \(-1,2,7,14,\ldots\)?
questions.stemZh: 下列哪一項可能表示數列 \(-1,2,7,14,\ldots\) 的第 \(n\) 項？
questions.solution: Substitute the indices \(n=1,2,3,4\) into each candidate. For B, \(n^2-2\) gives \(-1,2,7,14\), matching all four terms. A gives 1 at the first term; C gives 2; D fails at the third term, giving 14 instead of 7. Therefore B may represent the sequence. A finite list does not uniquely determine an infinite sequence, so the word “may” matters.
questions.solutionZh: 將 \(n=1,2,3,4\) 代入各選項。B 的 \(n^2-2\) 得 \(-1,2,7,14\)，四項全部吻合。A 的首項為 1；C 的首項為 2；D 的第三項為 14，並非 7。因此選 B。有限個已知項不能唯一決定整個無窮數列，題目問的是「可能」。

questions.stem: In the figure, the 1st pattern consists of 6 dots. For any positive integer \(n\), the \((n+1)\)th pattern is formed by adding \(2(n+2)\) dots to the nth pattern. Find the number of dots in the 5th pattern.
questions.stemZh: 圖中第一個圖案有 6 點。對任意正整數 \(n\)，在第 \(n\) 個圖案加上 \(2(n+2)\) 點，便得到第 \(n+1\) 個圖案。求第五個圖案的點數。
questions.solution: The additions for \(n=1,2,3,4\) are 6, 8, 10 and 12. Hence \[T_5=6+6+8+10+12=42.\] The initial 6 dots must be counted as well as the four additions. Answer: B.
questions.solutionZh: 由第一個圖案到第五個圖案，要依次代入 \(n=1,2,3,4\)，加上的點數是 6、8、10、12。因此 \[T_5=6+6+8+10+12=42.\] 記得包括原有的 6 點，共作四次增加。答案：B。

questions.stem:
Which of the following are arithmetic sequences?
I. \(1,1,1,1,\ldots\)
II. \(2,3,2,3,\ldots\)
III. \(1,2,4,7,\ldots\)
questions.stemZh:
下列哪些是等差數列？
I. \(1,1,1,1,\ldots\)
II. \(2,3,2,3,\ldots\)
III. \(1,2,4,7,\ldots\)
questions.solution: An AP has a constant difference between consecutive terms. I has difference 0, so it is an AP. II has differences 1, −1, 1; III has differences 1, 2, 3. The latter two are not APs. Answer: A (I only).
questions.solutionZh: 等差數列的相鄰項之差須固定。I 的公差為 0，所以是等差數列。II 的相鄰項差為 1、−1、1；III 則為 1、2、3，兩者均非等差數列。答案：A（只有 I）。

questions.stem: Mandy borrowed $2000 from her sister on 20 April 2016 and agreed to repay part of it on the first day of each month. Starting from the end of May 2016, the amounts owed at the end of the months were $1850, $1700, $1550, $1400, …, forming an arithmetic sequence. How much was the last repayment?
questions.stemZh: Mandy 於 2016 年 4 月 20 日向姐姐借了 $2000，並同意在每月第一天償還部分款項。由 2016 年 5 月底起，每月底所欠款項依次為 $1850、$1700、$1550、$1400、……，形成等差數列。最後一次還款是多少？
questions.solution: The balance decreases by $150 each month. Since \(2000=13(150)+50\), thirteen payments of $150 leave $50, which is the final repayment. Answer: A.
questions.solutionZh: 每月底的欠款減少 $150。由 \(2000=13(150)+50\)，還了十三次 $150 後尚欠 $50，所以最後一次還款為 $50。答案：A。

questions.stem: If four numbers are inserted between \(48\) and \(3/2048\) such that these six numbers form a geometric sequence, find the common ratio.
questions.stemZh: 在 \(48\) 與 \(3/2048\) 之間插入四個數，使這六個數形成等比數列。求公比。
questions.solution: There are six terms and five ratio steps. Thus \[48r^5=\frac3{2048},\qquad r^5=\frac1{32768}=\left(\frac18\right)^5.\] An odd power has just one real fifth root, so \(r=1/8\), not ±1/8. Answer: A.
questions.solutionZh: 六項之間有五次乘公比的步驟。故 \[48r^5=\frac3{2048},\qquad r^5=\frac1{32768}=\left(\frac18\right)^5.\] 五次方為奇次方，只有一個實五次方根，所以 \(r=1/8\)，不是正負兩值。答案：A。

questions.stem:
If \(a,b,c,d\) form a geometric sequence, which of the following must be true?
I. \(b/a,c/b,d/c\) form a geometric sequence.
II. \(a^2,b^2,d^2\) form a geometric sequence.
III. \(2^a,2^b,2^c\) form a geometric sequence.
questions.stemZh:
若 \(a,b,c,d\) 形成等比數列，下列哪些敘述必定正確？
I. \(b/a,c/b,d/c\) 形成等比數列。
II. \(a^2,b^2,d^2\) 形成等比數列。
III. \(2^a,2^b,2^c\) 形成等比數列。
questions.solution: The quotients displayed in I require \(a,b,c\ne0\); work on this domain. Let the common ratio be \(r\ne0\). Then I is \(r,r,r\), a GP of ratio 1. To disprove “must” in II and III, use the GP \(1,2,4,8\). II becomes \(1,4,64\), with ratios 4 and 16. III becomes \(2,4,16\), with ratios 2 and 4. Hence only I must hold: A. Domain note: if zero terms are admitted without requiring the displayed quotients to exist, the source item is undefined; A uses the nonzero domain implicit in those quotients.
questions.solutionZh: I 所列的商要求 \(a,b,c\ne0\)，以下在此定義域討論。設原公比為 \(r\ne0\)，I 便是 \(r,r,r\)，屬公比為 1 的等比數列。要推翻 II、III 的「必定」，可用 \(1,2,4,8\) 作反例：II 得 \(1,4,64\)，相鄰比為 4、16；III 得 \(2,4,16\)，相鄰比為 2、4。因此只有 I，答案 A。定義域提示：若容許零項而不要求題列商有定義，原題便不能成立；A 是按這些商隱含的非零定義域作答。

questions.stem: Find the sum of all the positive terms in the geometric sequence \(-32,8,-2,1/2,\ldots\).
questions.stemZh: 求等比數列 \(-32,8,-2,1/2,\ldots\) 中所有正數項的和。
questions.solution: The original ratio is \(-1/4\). The positive terms are the even-indexed terms \(8,1/2,1/32,\ldots\), which have ratio \(1/16\). Since \(|1/16|<1\), their sum is \[\frac8{1-1/16}=\frac{128}{15}.\] Do not sum the original alternating sequence. Answer: B.

questions.stem: The sum of the 2nd and 3rd terms of a geometric sequence is 1020. The sum of the 2nd and 5th terms is 1785. If the common ratio is positive, find the first term.
questions.stemZh: 一等比數列的第二及第三項之和為 1020，第二及第五項之和為 1785。若公比為正數，求首項。
questions.solution: Let the first term be \(a\) and ratio \(r>0\). Then \(ar(1+r)=1020\) and \(ar(1+r^3)=1785\). Divide to obtain \[r^2-r+1=\frac{1785}{1020}=\frac74.\] Thus \((2r-3)(2r+1)=0\). Positivity selects \(r=3/2\), excluding \(-1/2\). Therefore \[a=\frac{1020}{(3/2)(5/2)}=272.\] Check \(408+612=1020\) and \(408+1377=1785\). Answer: C.

questions.stem: \(a,a^2,a^3,\ldots\) is a geometric sequence with sum to infinity \(x\). Which range describes \(x\)?
questions.stemZh: 等比數列 \(a,a^2,a^3,\ldots\) 的無窮和為 \(x\)。求 \(x\) 的範圍。
questions.solution: Convergence requires \(-1<a<1\). Then \(x=a/(1-a)=1/(1-a)-1\). Since \(0<1-a<2\), \(x>-1/2\); every such x is achieved by \(a=x/(1+x)\).
questions.sourceZh: S6/Sequence/Sequence review2.pdf · 第2題（未提供原出處）

questions.stem: The product of the first n terms of the geometric sequence \(1,2,2^2,2^3,\ldots\) is \(2^{406}\). Find n.
questions.solution: Add exponents: \(0+1+\cdots+(n-1)=n(n-1)/2=406\). Thus \(n^2-n-812=0\), giving \(n=29\) or \(-28\). Reject the negative number of terms.
questions.sourceZh: S6/Sequence/Sequence review2.pdf · 第4題（未提供原出處）

questions.solution: The ratio is \(-1/x\) and its absolute value is below 1. Hence \(1/(1+1/x)=5/6\), so \(6x=5x+5\) and \(x=5\). This satisfies the domain.
questions.solutionZh: 公比為 \(-1/x\)，且絕對值小於 1。套用無窮等比和得 \(1/(1+1/x)=5/6\)，所以 \(x=5\)；代回符合原限制。
questions.sourceZh: S6/Sequence/Sequence review2.pdf · 第5題（未提供原出處）

questions.stem: Real numbers a,b,c form a geometric sequence. If \(a+b+c=14\) and \(abc=64\), find \(a+c\).
questions.stemZh: 實數 a、b、c 構成等比數列。若 \(a+b+c=14\) 且 \(abc=64\)，求 \(a+c\)。
questions.solution: The GP property gives \(ac=b^2\), hence \(abc=b^3=64\). The real root is \(b=4\), so \(a+c=14-4=10\).
questions.sourceZh: S6/Sequence/Sequence review2.pdf · 第6題（未提供原出處）

questions.stem: A sequence satisfies \(a_{n+2}=(a_n+a_{n+1})/2\) for every positive integer n. If \(a_1=a_2=4\), find \(a_{20}\).
questions.solution: The next term is the mean of two 4s, so it is 4. Repeating this argument shows every term equals 4. Thus \(a_{20}=4\).
questions.solutionZh: 每項是前兩項的平均值。由兩個 4 開始，下一項仍為 4；反覆使用相同推理，每項皆為 4，故 \(a_{20}=4\)。
questions.sourceZh: S6/Sequence/Sequence review2.pdf · 第7題（未提供原出處）

questions.stem: In the figure, the first pattern has 3 dots. For every positive integer n, pattern \(n+1\) is formed by adding \(2n+1\) dots to pattern n. Find the number of dots in the seventh pattern.
questions.stemZh: 如圖，第一個圖案有 3 點。對每個正整數 n，第 \(n+1\) 個圖案由第 n 個圖案加入 \(2n+1\) 點形成。求第七個圖案的點數。
questions.solution: \(3+\sum_{n=1}^{6}(2n+1)=3+2(21)+6=51\). Only six additions are needed to reach pattern 7.
questions.sourceZh: S6/Sequence/Sequence review2.pdf · 第8題（未提供原出處）

questions.stem: The 12th term of an arithmetic sequence is ten times its 6th term. The sum of the first 10 terms is −5. Find the second term.
questions.stemZh: 等差數列第 12 項是第 6 項的十倍，首 10 項之和為 −5。求第二項。
questions.solution: Let first term a and difference d. \(a+11d=10(a+5d)\) gives \(9a+39d=0\). Also \(5(2a+9d)=-5\). Solving gives \(d=-3,a=13\), hence \(T_2=a+d=10\).

questions.stem: Let \(a_n\) be the nth term of a GP of nonzero real numbers. Which are true? I. \(a_2,a_5,a_8,a_{11}\) form a GP. II. \(a_4^2=a_3a_5\). III. \(a_7/a_3>0\).
questions.stemZh: 設 \(a_n\) 為非零實數等比數列的第 n 項。以下哪些正確？I. \(a_2,a_5,a_8,a_{11}\) 成等比。II. \(a_4^2=a_3a_5\)。III. \(a_7/a_3>0\)。
questions.solution: Write \(a_n=ar^{n-1}\) with \(a\ne0,r\ne0\). I has ratio \(r^3\). II has both sides \(a^2r^6\). III equals \(r^4>0\), including negative r. All are true.
questions.solutionZh: 寫成 \(a_n=ar^{n-1}\)，其中 a、r 均非零。I 的公比為 \(r^3\)；II 兩邊同為 \(a^2r^6\)；III 為 \(r^4>0\)，即使 r 負亦成立。三項皆正確。
questions.sourceZh: S6/Sequence/Sequence review2.pdf · 第12題（未提供原出處）

questions.stem: In Figure 1, the first pattern has 5 dots. Each next pattern adds 2 dots. Find the least integer m such that the total number of dots in the first m patterns exceeds 7565.
questions.stemZh: 圖 1 的第一個圖案有 5 點，其後每個圖案增加 2 點。求最小整數 m，使首 m 個圖案的總點數超過 7565。
questions.solution: The numbers form an AP with a=5,d=2. \(S_m=m(2m+8)/2=m^2+4m\). The inequality is \((m-85)(m+89)>0\). For positive integers, \(m>85\), so the least is \(86\). At 85 the total only equals 7565.

questions.stem: Wilson deposits $P on the first day of each year for 10 years at Green Bank, at 6% p.a. compounded quarterly. If the total interest at the end of year 10 is $10000, find P to the nearest integer.
questions.stemZh: Wilson 連續 10 年於每年首日向 Green Bank 存入 $P，年利率 6%，按季複息。若第 10 年年底所得總利息為 $10000，求 P，答案取最接近整數。
questions.solution: The deposits earn 40,36,...,4 quarters of interest. Let \(g=1.015^4\). Final value \(P\sum_{k=1}^{10}g^k=Pg(g^{10}-1)/(g-1)\). Deduct the total principal 10P: \(P[g(g^{10}-1)/(g-1)-10]=10000\). Thus \(P=2451.26750\ldots\) and the requested answer is $2451.
questions.sourceZh: S6/Sequence/Sequence review2.pdf · 第14題（未提供原出處）

questions.stem: A city spends \(\$3.24\times10^{10}\) on education in year 1 of a plan. Each subsequent year it spends 5% more. (a) Find total expenditure in the first 15 years. (b) Find the least integer n such that expenditure in the first n years exceeds \(\$10^{12}\).
questions.stemZh: 某城市計劃第一年的教育開支為 \(\$3.24\times10^{10}\)，其後每年比前一年增加 5%。(a) 求首 15 年總開支。(b) 求最小整數 n，使首 n 年總開支超過 \(\$10^{12}\)。
questions.solution: Use \(S_n=3.24\times10^{10}(1.05^n-1)/0.05\). (a) \(S_{15}\approx6.99145460258566\times10^{11}\) dollars, or \(6.99\times10^{11}\) to 3 significant figures. (b) \(1.05^n>206/81\) gives \(n>\log(206/81)/\log(1.05)\approx19.13146\). The least integer is 20; check n=19 and20 directly.
questions.sourceZh: S6/Sequence/Sequence review2.pdf · 第15題（未提供原出處）

questions.stem: Boxes numbered 1,2,3,... contain numbers of one-dollar coins forming a GP. The third and fourth boxes contain 12 and24 coins. (a) Find the number in box 1. (b) Find the least n such that the total in boxes \(n,n+1,\ldots,2n\) exceeds $48960.
questions.stemZh: 編號 1、2、3、… 的盒內各有若干一元硬幣，數量成等比數列。第 3、4 盒分別有 12、24 枚。(a) 求第 1 盒數量。(b) 求最小 n，使第 \(n,n+1,\ldots,2n\) 盒總金額超過 $48960。
questions.solution: (a) \(r=24/12=2\) and \(a=12/2^2=3\). (b) The inclusive range has n+1 boxes: \(\sum_{k=n}^{2n}3\cdot2^{k-1}=3(2^{2n}-2^{n-1})\). Let t=2ⁿ. The condition becomes \((2t+255)(t-128)>0\). Since t>0, \(2^n>128\); the least n is8. At n=7 the sum equals48960.

questions.stem: In the figure, ABC is an equilateral triangle of side 2 units. Square \(B_1C_1D_1E_1\) is inside ABC with \(A,B_1,B\), \(A,C_1,C\) and \(B,E_1,D_1,C\) collinear respectively. (a) Find \(C_1D_1\). (b) Square \(B_2C_2D_2E_2\) is similarly inscribed in \(\triangle AB_1C_1\), with \(A,B_2,B_1\), \(A,C_2,C_1\) and \(B_1,E_2,D_2,C_1\) collinear. Find \(C_2D_2\). (c) Repeat to obtain a GP of square sides. Find (i) the common ratio; (ii) the sum to infinity of \(C_1D_1+C_2D_2+C_3D_3+\cdots\). Give rationalized surd answers.
questions.stemZh: 如圖，ABC 是邊長為 2 的等邊三角形。內接正方形 \(B_1C_1D_1E_1\) 滿足 \(A,B_1,B\)、\(A,C_1,C\)、\(B,E_1,D_1,C\) 分別共線。(a) 求 \(C_1D_1\)。(b) 在 \(\triangle AB_1C_1\) 同樣內接正方形 \(B_2C_2D_2E_2\)，其中 \(A,B_2,B_1\)、\(A,C_2,C_1\)、\(B_1,E_2,D_2,C_1\) 分別共線，求 \(C_2D_2\)。(c) 持續相同過程，正方形邊長成等比數列，求 (i) 公比；(ii) 邊長無窮和。答案用根式表示並有理化。
questions.solution: For an equilateral triangle of side L, inscribed square side s satisfies \(s=(L-s)\sin60^\circ\). Thus \(s/L=\sqrt3/(2+\sqrt3)=2\sqrt3-3\). (a) With L=2, \(s_1=4\sqrt3-6\). (b) The next triangle side is s₁, so \(s_2=s_1(2\sqrt3-3)=42-24\sqrt3\). (c)(i) \(r=2\sqrt3-3\) lies between0and1. (ii) \(S_\infty=(4\sqrt3-6)/(1-r)=\sqrt3\).
questions.solutionZh: 設等邊三角形邊長 L、內接正方形邊長 s。由直角三角形得 \(s=(L-s)\sin60^\circ\)，故 \(s/L=2\sqrt3-3\)。(a) \(s_1=4\sqrt3-6\)。(b) 下一等邊三角形的邊長為 \(s_1\)，所以 \(s_2=42-24\sqrt3\)。(c)(i) 公比 \(2\sqrt3-3\)；(ii) 因其絕對值小於 1，無窮和 \((4\sqrt3-6)/(1-(2\sqrt3-3))=\sqrt3\)。

questions.stem: Alex has a permanent full-time job paying $10000 per month in year1, increasing10% at the beginning of each subsequent year. He may either take a spare-time job earning an additional $3000 per month, or study a two-year master degree during spare time. After study his monthly full-time pay in year3 becomes $15000 and thereafter rises10% yearly; he takes no part-time job. Let \(P_n,F_n\) be his respective annual salaries under the part-time and study routes. (a) Express \(P_n\) in n. (b)(i) Find \(F_1,F_2\); (ii) express \(F_n\) for \(n\ge3\). Let \(A_m,B_m\) be total salaries over m years under the respective routes. (c) Show that \(A_m-B_m=12000[3m-29(1.1^{m-2}-1)]\) for \(m\ge3\). (d) Which route earns more if he retires at the end of year10?
questions.stemZh: Alex 第一年的全職月薪為 $10000，其後每年年初加薪 10%。他可在工餘兼職，每月另賺 $3000；或在工餘修讀兩年碩士，完成後第三年的全職月薪為 $15000，其後每年仍加薪 10%，不再兼職。設 \(P_n,F_n\) 分別為兼職及進修方案第 n 年的年薪。(a) 以 n 表示 \(P_n\)。(b)(i) 求 \(F_1,F_2\)；(ii) 以 n 表示 \(n\ge3\) 時的 \(F_n\)。設 \(A_m,B_m\) 為兩方案首 m 年總薪金。(c) 證明 \(A_m-B_m=12000[3m-29(1.1^{m-2}-1)]\)，其中 \(m\ge3\)。(d) 若第 10 年年底退休，哪個方案總薪金較高？
questions.solution: (a) \(P_n=120000(1.1)^{n-1}+36000\). (b) Study is during spare time: \(F_1=120000,F_2=132000\) and \(F_n=180000(1.1)^{n-3}\ (n\ge3)\). (c) \(A_m=1200000(1.1^m-1)+36000m\); \(B_m=252000+1800000(1.1^{m-2}-1)\). Subtract and use \(1.1^m=1.21(1.1^{m-2})\) to obtain the required identity. (d) \(A_{10}-B_{10}\approx-37968.91\), so study earns about $37968.91 more. No tuition cost is specified, so compare salaries only.
